ui.phone_pairing.popup.title: A phone wants to pair with this computer
ui.phone_pairing.popup.grant: Approving lets this phone approve anything your agents ask permission for on this computer, just like clicking Approve here, and get this computer's notifications. Computers that join this one later will trust it too.
ui.phone_pairing.popup.attested: Requested by a phone signed in to your Radient account
ui.phone_pairing.popup.compare: Check that the phone shows the same six digits.
ui.phone_pairing.popup.anti_phishing: Only approve if you just asked to pair your own phone. If you didn't, deny it.
ui.phone_pairing.popup.type_code_label: Type the six digits shown on the phone
ui.phone_pairing.popup.type_code_hint: This computer doesn't show the code for this request, so typing it proves the request came from that phone.
ui.phone_pairing.popup.wrong_code: Those digits don't match the code on the phone. Nothing was approved. {count, plural, one {# try left.} other {# tries left.}}
ui.phone_pairing.popup.invalid_code: That isn't six digits. Type the six digits the phone shows.
ui.phone_pairing.popup.signing: {os, select, mac {Confirm on your Mac. The prompt may be behind this window.} windows {Confirm on your PC. The prompt may be behind this window.} other {Confirm on your computer. The prompt may be behind this window.}}
ui.phone_pairing.popup.admin_prompt: {os, select, mac {Your Mac is asking for its password to add this phone. The prompt may be behind this window.} windows {Your PC is asking for its password to add this phone. The prompt may be behind this window.} other {Your computer is asking for its password to add this phone. The prompt may be behind this window.}}
ui.phone_pairing.popup.failed: Confirmation was cancelled on this computer, so nothing was installed yet.
ui.phone_pairing.popup.paired: Paired. This phone can now approve requests on this computer.
ui.phone_pairing.popup.manage_where: You can remove it any time in Settings → Radient account → Paired phones.
ui.phone_pairing.popup.denied: Denied. Nothing was installed on this computer.
ui.phone_pairing.popup.strikes: The code didn't match three times, so this request is closed. Nothing was installed. Ask the phone to start pairing again.
ui.phone_pairing.popup.expired: This request expired before it was approved. Nothing was installed. Ask the phone to start pairing again.
ui.phone_pairing.popup.changed: This request changed since it was shown. Nothing was approved; review it again.
ui.phone_pairing.popup.error: This computer couldn't record your decision. Nothing was approved; try again.
ui.phone_pairing.popup.unavailable: This computer isn't set up to let phones approve requests yet. Turn on phone approvals first, or deny this request.
ui.phone_pairing.popup.unavailable_where: You can also turn them on in Settings → Phone access, or in the terminal app with /mobile approvals on.
ui.phone_pairing.setup.title: Let phones approve requests on this computer
ui.phone_pairing.setup.body: {os, select, mac {Your Mac asks for its password once to turn this on.} windows {Your PC asks for its password once to turn this on.} other {Your computer asks for its password once to turn this on.}}
ui.phone_pairing.setup.finish_reason: The password prompt was cancelled, so setup isn't finished.
ui.phone_pairing.setup.working: {os, select, mac {Waiting for your Mac's password prompt. It may be behind this window.} windows {Waiting for your PC's password prompt. It may be behind this window.} other {Waiting for your computer's password prompt. It may be behind this window.}}
ui.phone_pairing.setup.on: {os, select, mac {Phone approvals are on. Each new phone will still ask for your Mac's password once.} windows {Phone approvals are on. Each new phone will still ask for your PC's password once.} other {Phone approvals are on. Each new phone will still ask for your computer's password once.}}
ui.phone_pairing.setup.error: Phone approvals couldn't be turned on. Nothing changed; try again.
ui.phone_pairing.phones.title: Paired phones
ui.phone_pairing.phones.subtitle: These phones can approve requests on this computer and get its notifications.
ui.phone_pairing.phones.empty: No phones are paired. When a phone asks to pair, you'll approve it here.
ui.phone_pairing.phones.unconfirmed: Not confirmed yet. This phone can't approve requests until its pairing finishes on this computer.
ui.phone_pairing.phones.removing: {os, select, mac {Can't approve anymore. One step needs your Mac's password.} windows {Can't approve anymore. One step needs your PC's password.} other {Can't approve anymore. One step needs your computer's password.}}
ui.phone_pairing.phones.dialog_body: It will no longer be able to approve requests or get notifications. It can still open chats while signed in to your Radient account — sign out on the phone to stop that.
ui.phone_pairing.phones.dialog_again: It can ask to pair again later — you'll approve it the same way.
ui.phone_pairing.phones.dialog_gesture: {os, select, mac {Your Mac will ask for its password to finish removing it.} windows {Your PC will ask for its password to finish removing it.} other {Your computer will ask for its password to finish removing it.}}
ui.phone_pairing.phones.still_removing: This phone can no longer approve requests or get notifications here, but one step didn't finish. Use Finish removing to complete it.
ui.phone_pairing.phones.not_found: That phone is no longer on this computer's list.
ui.phone_pairing.phones.error: This phone couldn't be removed. Try again.
ui.phone_pairing.phones.load_error: The paired phones couldn't be read.
ui.phone_pairing.password.body: If your phone reaches this computer through your own tunnel instead of your Radient account, it signs in with this computer's phone password.
ui.phone_pairing.password.label: Phone password
ui.phone_pairing.password.copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Show the password and copy it by hand.
ui.phone_pairing.password.error: The phone password couldn't be read. Try again.
